answer: Milestone bonds stop mass fake identities. A newcomer enters a public inlet, stakes 70, and files its key. To climb, it stands on a ledge with fresh signed proof; a hash bridge links each ledge to the last proof, blocking reuse. First filing 36, k-th 36+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 4,032,000 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. A rented ledge fails the bridge check and burns the stake. An honest identity pays 36 once, keeps its bond.
